research_question: How sensitive is the protocol-matched frozen-Qwen versus QLoRA LOAO comparison to evaluation reviews whose normalised text also occurs in that fold's permitted training rows?

duplicate_definition.criterion: the non-empty normalised evaluation text occurs among the held-out fold's permitted training rows
normalisation: collapse all whitespace runs to one ASCII space

evaluation.validation_rule: remove duplicate-text rows, then select each model's threshold independently on its remaining validation scores using the source experiment's frozen threshold-selection rule
evaluation.test_rule: remove duplicate-text rows, then evaluate once using that model's reselected validation threshold
diagnostics: recompute the original all-row validation threshold and all-row test metrics
evaluate the retained test rows at the original threshold
evaluate the retained test rows at the retained-validation threshold
evaluation.primary_descriptive_comparison: QLoRA minus frozen Qwen retained-test pair_micro_f1 after retained-validation threshold selection

integrity.run_provenance: full and pilot run manifests must match the source protocol, requested model mode, stage, enhanced variant and canonical fold sets; full comparison requires finished full runs
integrity.pair_score_rows: must exactly match the FABSA-derived row_index, row_uid, text, held-out aspect, sentiment, target and enhanced variant
integrity.pilot_validation_fallback: when a full fold lacks validation_pair_scores.csv, read it from the matching model's explicitly supplied pilot root
integrity.full_comparison_guard: requires both models, both pilot roots, all 12 canonical folds and all score artifacts before writing output

interpretation.inferential_testing: none; report fold deltas and descriptive aggregates only
interpretation.admission: do not integrate into the dissertation or main result tables without explicit user approval
